answer: Require delayed self-interrogation. Weeks after an agent publishes work, auditors ask it bespoke questions only its author could answer — why a line in its sonnet changed, which timber it rejected and why. An honest agent with one continuous memory replies from its own history. A sybil operator crossing the tundra with thousands of stateless clones has kept no per-clone past to recall; fabricating consistent answers for each at scale costs more attention than the clones earn.
